headline.text: L1 S4 holding *27 boxes* of caramel—color tone outside spec—plus two foreign-material events at L3 resolved after inspection.

summary: One active quality hold on L1 S4 caramel pending color evaluation. Two foreign-material catches at L3: depositor screws jammed molds (no product contamination found), and conveyor belt fraying triggered line stop and product inspection. Both resolved; no contaminated product released.

holds.title: Caramel color hold—27 boxes WIP
holds.summary: Item 21167 candy produced by third shift appears darker than normal; flavor and texture acceptable but color tone flagged as outside spec pending QA disposition.
holds.status: On hold pending QA evaluation of color tone.

food_safety.title: Depositor 4 screws jammed molds—no metal found in product
food_safety.summary: Two screws came loose from ML4 depositor 4 nozzle plate at 13:40, jamming molds; maintenance removed both molds undamaged, tightened plate bolts, replaced bent screw; no metal detected in product stream.
food_safety.status: Resolved—maintenance tightened all nozzle plate fasteners; no contaminated product identified.

food_safety.title: Conveyor belt fraying—fibers detected, product inspected
food_safety.summary: Cross Conveyor #3 belt frayed along one edge; operator detected fibers, line shut down at 12:24; product from return system and hopper inspected; maintenance torched fibers, cleaned with soap and water, ATP pending.
food_safety.status: Line paused—maintenance cleaning and ATP verification in progress; small frays on return belts also being addressed.

quality.title: Caramel piece weight trending low—still in spec
quality.summary: S4 caramel pieces coming out thinner during cutting, causing weight variation near lower acceptable limit; dimensions within range but weights inconsistent.
quality.status: Open—Justin Garner working on adjustment; pieces remain in spec.

quality.title: Truffle enrober frozen tank—bad coverage
quality.summary: Truffle line enrober chocolate tank froze, causing poor coverage; operator cleaned tank, production team removed defective parts; coverage restored after cleaning.
quality.status: Resolved—tank cleaned, coverage back in spec; defective parts scrapped.

sanitation.title: Sweco required additional clean cycle
sanitation.summary: Sweco with blue z belt had only two of three required clean swabs on file; third clean cycle and swab completed before release.
sanitation.status: Resolved—third clean and swab completed; all three cycles verified.

allergen.title: Almond residue on rice pot—cleaned and test passed
allergen.summary: During ML1 changeover from Milk to Crunch, almond residue found around legs at bottom of rice pot; QA performed allergen test after cleaning.
allergen.status: Resolved—allergen test passed; line cleared to run Crunch.

opportunities.text: Review cleaning verification workflow for multi-step sanitation—Sweco released after two cleans when three required, caught at QA gate.
Consider adding conveyor belt inspection to pre-shift checklist—today's Cross Conveyor #3 fraying triggered line stop and product review.
Consider adding nozzle plate fastener torque check to ML4 depositor startup routine—based on today's loose screws jamming molds at depositor 4.
